#### ⚠️ **Critical Constraints**
1. **[VM-RAM-MAX-10-75GB]**  
   ➤ No VM may exceed **10.75 GB RAM**. Applies to all instance types and container resource limits.  
   ➤ Owner: A2 (Infrastructure)

2. **[EXT-PORTS-TLS-1-3]**  
   ➤ All externally exposed ports must enforce **TLS 1.3 only** (no downgrade allowed).  
   ➤ Must be implemented in NGINX ingress and certificate bindings.  
   ➤ Owner: A3 (Security)

2. **Await confirmation from A3** that NGINX ingress enforces TLS 1.3 on all external ports.
3. Upon receipt of both confirmations:
   - Validate completeness.

  ```nginx
  ssl_protocols TLSv1.3;
  ssl_prefer_server_ciphers off;
  ```
